title: CMB transaction surface
description: Input schema for China Merchants Bank personal internet banking or CMB App transaction-detail surface. Foreign-currency sub-accounts are out of scope. Electronic receipts (电子回单) share this shape but may omit peer fields; only matched receipt-to-transfer pairs are accepted.

amountCents.description: Amount in cents (yuan * 100). Two-decimal precision required.

status.description: Bank-reported status. Only 'success' is accepted for final matching.

timestampUtc.description: ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC as recorded by the bank surface.

name.description: Payer display name. May be partially masked on the surface.

accountNumber.description: Payer account number. Often partially masked; never post real values in Git.

name.description: Payee display name. May be partially masked on the surface.

accountNumber.description: Payee account number. Often partially masked.

transactionId.description: Bank-reported transaction ID (交易流水号). Scope is CMB internal; interbank IDs are not cross-bank normalized.

memo.description: Optional transfer memo (附言). Treated as untrusted text; never used for matching or validation beyond presence.
